Haryana seeks Singapore investment for tech and growth hubs

Haryana has presented itself as a hub for technology and investment to Singaporean firms, seeking their participation in the development of Panchkula, Karnal, and Rohtak as future growth centers. The state aims to attract foreign investment and technological collaboration.
